patch.value: Factor shared criterion evidence into one revision-bound fragment
Read-only within-packet evidence factoring with complete criterion and item citation paths, typed SDK and compact CLI output.
Twenty bindings to one fragment retain twenty traceable bindings and one text copy; Distinct revisions never collapse; Equivalent expanded and factored packets cover the same criteria

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: existing evidence-packing.ts packs explicit criterion/item/field bindings but repeats value_json per criterion. Core read-output sessions use id/ref references across calls; task-phase.ts already consumes that host convention. pm-memory consolidation persists durable knowledge; pm-evidence resolves source citations. This feature is read-only within-packet factoring, preserving every binding and revision identity with no new store, import, sync, journal, status interpretation or tracker mutation path. Reuse SDK authoritative reads, history snapshots and host id/ref convention; retain legacy expanded v1 output. No transaction isolation is claimed.

value.text: Review round 1: general rule is that an exhausted residual budget is a successful terminal state, never an admissible zero budget for an SDK selector requiring positive capacity. Whole-package audit found exactly three packContextCandidates callers: shared-evidence.ts lacked exhaustion handling; evidence-packing.ts already guards budget > overhead; index.ts createSdkPacker bypasses nonpositive item slots. No other selector calls exist in source/generated runtime. Fix terminates shared packing at equality, preserving inclusive byte ceilings. Added 500 seeded exact/adjacent boundary cases across source/built SDKs, JSON/TOON, factored/expanded, plus legacy producer and zero-slot checks and installed no-git Node/Bun CLI reproduction. No additional non-blocking finding was supplied or exposed in PR review comments; none is being silently dismissed.
